caption:
Boot off after weeks, and Koko's ankle feels stiff, puffy and a bit unfamiliar. That's common.

Every fracture and every repair is different, so your surgeon or treating doctor sets how much weight you can take. Good rehab works within that plan. If your doctor agrees, elevation, gentle ankle pumps and tracing the alphabet with your toes are often a good starting point, followed by even walking, strength and balance.

Worsening calf pain or swelling, a red or hot wound, or numbness in the foot need prompt medical review. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios work alongside your doctor's protocol. Book online via the link in bio
